notes.title: Semblance v1.0.3 Update + OST Release
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32274558/73e88b89951edb0db8c5ed847ea0a4ad609ff0c0.jpg[/img]

For links to the Semblance Original Soundtrack, please check out the Nyamakop social media pages.

BUG FIXES
-  Music now fades rather than cutting when transitioning from level to overworld minor
- Fixed platform highlighting constantly even if there's no reset beam touching it

USABILITY FEATURE ADDITIONS
- After game completion, the player can revisit the entire game without the game resetting to the title screen. This allows players to find all the secrets/crystal mosquitoes while still allowing them to finish the game. (You cannot do the ending again)
- Allow players to pause during final cinematics
- Removed certain Menu options in final cinematics
- Player can reset squish at all points during the game, not only in puzzles
- Option to turn off auto dashing assists in pause menu
- Added achievement for killing all crystal mosquitoes in game.
- Added Cloud Save

notes.title: Semblance Patch version 1.0.2 live
notes.content:
Folks, here's a new patch for Semblance!

This is mainly about reducing the likelyhood of getting stuck in walls, as well as some gamplay fixes! Full patch notes below!

[b]This generally improves the quality of life for gameplay[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32274558/9352984f91d9ae1108df001a389ea06f2f92b1a9.jpg[/img]

BUG FIXES
[list]
[*]Eliminated Infinite dashing, which could result in Squish getting stuck and player unable to access menu.
[*]Drastically reduced likelihood of getting stuck in walls
[*]Various hitboxes adjusted for clearer feedback
[*]Missing dressing in certain camera views
[*]Fixed Semblance title screen remaining after finishing game and letting credits roll fully
[*]Fixed certain shape changes not being recorded for “Polymorphic” Achievement 
[/list]
GAMEPLAY FIXES
[list]
[*]Removed ability to open debug menu
[*]Feedback for platform not deforming (if deformation attempted with nearby platform) now pushes Squish away, stopping Squish getting stuck in walls. 
[*]Squish now gets thrown out from underneath portals when loading into an area.
[*]Changed order of totems indicators on World 2 tree to be clearer on position of totems in world 2
[*]Rare corrupted save files occurrences now result in text indicator and not showing black screen 
[*]Localisation for corrupted save file text indicator
[*]Intro scene reloads correctly if you enter intro scene tree and leave it without collecting essence.
[*]Reinstated small cooldown for dashing when thrown out of platform
[*]Fixed flying laser from clipping into wall in ending area.
[*]In World 2, made the vertical velocity of being thrown sideways out of platforms occur more reliably
[*]Puzzle tweaks/workarounds fixed (specific puzzles list below)
[/list]

Format: (level - puzzle)
[b]World 1:[/b]
[list]
[*]1-6
[*]4-5
[*]4-5
[/list]

[b]World 2:[/b]
[list]
[*]2-5
[*]5-1
[*]5-3
[*]6-1
[/list]

[b]World 3[/b]
[list]
[*]1-5
[*]3-1
[*]3-3
[*]3-5
[*]5-2
[/list]
